female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-family-future-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
female-family-future-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly mention securing the future of their family are associated with increased funding speed.

female-inventory-detail-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify exact quantities or types of business inventory fund faster.
female-inventory-detail-faster.body: Pitches from women that provide concrete details regarding the amount or variety of their inventory are associated with increased funding speed.

female-sales-context-faster.body: Female borrowers who specify the timing or location of their sales may fund faster.

female-general-store-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention running a general store business may fund more slowly.

hardship-detail-faster-general.body: Mentioning specific living or family hardships may accelerate funding regardless of gender.

female-hardworking-entrepreneur-slower.body: Female borrowers who use the specific phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund more slowly.

female-children-education-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention paying for their children's education may fund more slowly.

male-trade-history-faster.body: Male borrowers who describe a lifelong history with their trade may fund faster.

female-currency-php-faster.body: Female borrowers who list the loan amount in PHP may fund faster.

male-loan-count-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention a specific number of previous loans may fund slower.

female-marital-status-faster.body: Female borrowers who identify as married, particularly in education-related pitches, may fund faster than those who identify as single.

female-hardworking-entrepreneur-slower.title: Female borrowers who describe themselves as a hardworking entrepreneur may fund more slowly.
female-hardworking-entrepreneur-slower.retrospective: Retired due to staleness to make room for new puzzles.

female-husband-occupation-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention their husband's specific occupation may fund more slowly.

female-name-repetition-faster.title: Female borrowers who repeat their name in the second sentence instead of using a pronoun may fund faster.

female-boilerplate-phrasing-slower.title: Female borrowers who use nearly identical or templated phrasing may fund more slowly.

female-struggle-narrative-slower.title: Female borrowers who include detailed narratives of family struggle or widowhood may fund more slowly.
female-struggle-narrative-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that hardships accelerate funding for women.

female-hardworking-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe themselves as hardworking or using 'works hard' may fund faster.
female-hardworking-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that 'hardworking entrepreneur' predicts slower funding.

female-nwtf-mention-faster.title: Pitches from women that explicitly mention the institution NWTF are associated with increased funding speed.
female-nwtf-mention-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promotion of female-gratitude-slower.

female-gratitude-slower.title: Pitches from women that contain direct gratitude markers toward lenders are associated with decreased funding speed.
female-gratitude-slower.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promotion of female-inventory-detail-faster.

female-family-size-detail-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide a specific count of their children may fund faster.
female-family-size-detail-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific family status and child counts were present in slower pitches.

female-mention-age-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention their specific age in the pitch may fund more slowly.
female-mention-age-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that faster pitches explicitly state age.
